title: Spyglass: Fully Launched and Optimized
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, which has transitioned from beta to a fully refined and powerful tool, ready to enhance your daily workflow.

title: Seamless File Management
summary: Take complete control of your files and images within the editor, with new options to upload, manage, and customize their appearance for a perfect look.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dynamic roadmap page, providing a transparent view of our latest achievements, upcoming features, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more intuitive and visually cohesive workflow with our upgraded checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and manage your tasks.

title: Seamless Co-editing, Enhanced for You
summary: We've refined our editor to deliver a more intuitive and efficient real-time collaboration experience, making teamwork smoother and more productive.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Ideas
summary: Boost your collaborative potential with improved search and discovery that brings all your shared items and ideas to the forefront.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are opening Noeko's codebase to empower our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive support for international languages.

title: Revitalizing Our Look: New and Improved Themes
summary: We are enhancing our existing themes and introducing a diverse collection of beautiful new designs to provide you with more options for personalizing your visual experience.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge Universe
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge with an enhanced Constellation view, allowing you to effortlessly filter by tags and time, and clearly visualize all your shared items and collaborators.

title: Advanced Search and Custom Collections
summary: Pinpoint information instantly with powerful new filtering and sorting options, and save your tailored searches as custom collections for quick access to your most relevant knowledge.

title: Interactive Content Views
summary: Unlock new possibilities for visualizing and interacting with linked content directly within your notes, transforming how you structure and engage with your information.

title: Noeko Goes Public: Self-Host and Premium Access
summary: Experience Noeko your way with upcoming self-hosting options and premium plans tailored to fit your team's needs.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring our greetings always match the exact time of day, providing a more intuitive and personalized experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by removing them in bulk directly from any list view, making organization quicker and more efficient.

title: Expand Your Content Universe
summary: Soon, you'll be able to easily add and interact with content from YouTube videos, websites, and text files, vastly increasing your accessible information sources.
